summary: XP Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a planned and mutually agreed CFO succession. Current CFO Victor Andreu Mansur Farinassi will step down effective May 31, 2026, with CEO Thiago Maffra serving as interim CFO until Gustavo Alejo Viviani takes over on August 3, 2026. Alejo, a CFA and former Santander executive, was appointed by the Board. No financial terms, shareholder vote, or advisor are mentioned. This is a routine executive transition, not a forced departure or activist-driven change. Watch for any strategic shifts under the new CFO but no risk-arb angle exists.
